trans.sense: family of sauces and soups made with egg, lemon juice and broth

examples.text: Fish may be poached and the liquor used to make an avgolemono sauce.

examples.text: Avgolemono is a traditional Greek chicken and lemon soup that rarely contains anything but chicken, lemon, eggs, and sometimes rice or onion.
